title: Web page and static server
problem: Users need the split in a phone browser (brief: Users, Success criteria 3-4). Serve one page plus split.js from a tiny Node server that is also the deploy target.
facts: src/split.js exposes window.splitBill when loaded without CommonJS (src/split.js, last lines)
assumptions: Hosts set PORT; default 3000 is fine locally
design: Browser: form -> app.js parses amounts to integer cents -> window.splitBill -> list. Server: GET / -> public/index.html, GET /app.js, GET /split.js -> src/split.js; everything else 404. Files come from an allow-list, never from joining the URL onto a directory.
security: OWASP ASVS V12 (files/resources): allow-list of served paths, so path traversal (/../package.json, encoded variants) cannot reach the filesystem; the smoke test asserts 404 for traversal attempts. V14: nosniff and CSP default-src 'self'. No user data is stored or sent.
